forks.title: Move session storage from the app database to a cache tier
forks.summary: Sessions live in the primary database. A cache tier would cut read load, but nobody has measured how much of the load is sessions.
forks.parked_because: No measurement yet; the fix might be aimed at the wrong thing.
forks.trigger: After the query-load breakdown in F-002 is published

history.note: trigger fired: load breakdown published; sessions are 41% of reads

forks.title: Break down database load by query family
forks.summary: Which query families account for the read load? Needed before choosing between caching, indexing and read replicas.
forks.closed_by: Measured and written up in docs/load-notes.md

history.note: closed: Measured and written up in docs/load-notes.md

forks.title: Read replicas instead of a cache tier
forks.summary: Replicas would also cut read load and need no invalidation logic. Rejected for now on cost.
forks.parked_because: Hosting quote was three times the cache option.
forks.trigger: If the cache tier's invalidation bugs exceed two incidents in a quarter
